title: Application of Novel Ruthenium (II) Polypyridyl Complexes as Robust DNA Probes, Optical Material and Antimicrobials-An Experimental and DFT Approach.
authors: Kodipaka, Aruna; Vuradi, Ravi Kumar; Airva, Praveen Kumar; Nambigari, Navaneetha; Sirasani, Satyanarayana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌多吡啶配合物与DNA的嵌入结合，采用实验和DFT计算及分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法以DFT和对接为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: The nature of the interaction of DNA with heteroleptic Ruthenium (II) Polypyridyl complexes of the type [Ru (A)(2)TPIP](2+), where TPIP = 2-(1-p-tolyl-1H pyrazol-4 -yl)-1H-imidazo [4, 5-f[1. 10] phenanthroline and A = 1,10 phenanthroline (1),4,4'-dimethyl-1,10-ortho Phenanthroline (2), 2,2' - bipyridine (3) and 4, 4' dimethyl 2, 2'- bipyridine (4), has been investigated by experimentaland molecular docking approaches. The order of the DNA binding affinities of the synthesised complexes is 1 > 2 > 3 > 4. The findings imply that the unsubstituted complex has a better affinity to bind with DNA than the substituted (dmp and dmb) emphasizing the significance of the auxiliary ligand. Additionally, as the medium's ionic strength drops, the DNA/Ru ratio rises, or when water is displaced by glycerol, the intercalation of complexes into DNA increases. DFT calculations at the B3LYP/LANL2MB level was used for molecular geometry (Ground State) and electronic characteristic calculations. The HOMO-LUMO gap of the Ru [II] complex is less than the intercalator and hence kinetically labile. Among the complexes, the bpy complex has shown utmost non-linear optical properties (alpha = -153.9099 10(-24)esu and beta = 3.8498 10(-30)esu). The docking study shows the significance of the Metal-intercalator's shorter length may increase DNA binding affinity. This study divulges that the Ruthenium (II) polypyridyl complexes bind to DNA preponderantly by intercalation supporting Viscosity studies. All the complexes have a considerable attraction for guanine. The standard disk diffusion method reveals that complexes (1, 2, 3 and 4) have good antibacterial activity.
abstract_zh: 研究了DNA与杂配钌(II)多吡啶配合物[Ru(A)₂TPIP]²⁺（其中TPIP = 2-(1-对甲苯基-1H-吡唑-4-基)-1H-咪唑并[4,5-f][1,10]菲咯啉，A = 1,10-菲咯啉 (1)、4,4'-二甲基-1,10-邻菲咯啉 (2)、2,2'-联吡啶 (3) 和4,4'-二甲基-2,2'-联吡啶 (4)）相互作用的性质，通过实验和分子对接方法进行了探究。合成配合物对DNA的结合亲和力顺序为1 > 2 > 3 > 4。研究结果表明，未取代的配合物比取代的（dmp和dmb）具有更好的DNA结合亲和力，强调了辅助配体的重要性。此外，随着介质离子强度降低、DNA/Ru比例升高，或当水被甘油替代时，配合物嵌入DNA的程度增加。使用B3LYP/LANL2MB水平的DFT计算用于分子几何（基态）和电子特性计算。Ru[II]配合物的HOMO-LUMO能隙小于嵌入剂，因此在动力学上不稳定。在这些配合物中，bpy配合物表现出最高的非线性光学性质（α = -153.9099 × 10⁻²⁴ esu 和 β = 3.8498 × 10⁻³⁰ esu）。对接研究表明，金属-嵌入剂较短的长度可能增加DNA结合亲和力。本研究揭示，钌(II)多吡啶配合物主要通过嵌入方式与DNA结合，支持了粘度研究的结果。所有配合物对鸟嘌呤具有显著的吸引力。标准纸片扩散法显示，配合物（1、2、3和4）具有良好的抗菌活性。
